label: Electricity price
description: Price per kWh paid for charging (the standard is the public DC fast-charging price)

label: Voluntary insurance
unit: % of the car's value per year
description: Comprehensive cover (class 1, Vollkasko) ÷ the car's value at the start of the year, per powertrain

label: Lowest voluntary premium
description: The premium once the car's value is low (owners move to cheaper cover)

label: Servicing
description: Scheduled servicing per year, per powertrain

label: Tyre set, regular car
description: Four tyres fitted to a regular car

label: Tyre set, premium car
description: Four tyres fitted to a premium car (larger wheels)

label: Tyre life
description: Life of a set at the reference mass; heavier cars wear their tyres faster in proportion

label: Tyre life applies at
description: The mass the tyre life applies to

label: Repairs after the warranty
unit: % of the purchase price per year
description: Repairs that the warranty no longer pays for

label: Warranty
description: Years before the owner pays for repairs (a bloc's legal minimum or the brands' usual warranty)

label: 12 V battery lasts
description: Years between 12 V battery replacements (fewer in hot climates)

label: Loss of value
description: Loss of value per year (% of the value at the start of the year), per powertrain
